name: Shiodome Hiiro
source:
A classmate belonging to the same class as the protagonist, at the school.

A girl admired by everyone, having a good nature and beautiful.
There was no gap between her outer and inner self, kind of a superwoman. Due to her specifications being so high, she was not seen as an object of romantic interest by anyone.

Actually, has no romantic experience and knowledge regarding it, is scarce.

She is under the impression that she has no charms as a woman.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=727030]Getchu[/url]]
